fields.climate: tropical, modified by southeast trade winds; warm, dry winter (May to November); hot, wet, humid summer (November to May)
fields.terrain: small coastal plain rising to discontinuous mountains encircling central plateau
fields.hazards: cyclones (November to April); almost completely surrounded by reefs that may pose maritime hazards
fields.farm: sugarcane, chicken, pumpkins/squash, tomatoes, eggs, potatoes, cabbages, bananas, onions, cucumbers/gherkins
fields.exports: fish, garments, raw sugar, fertilizers, diamonds
fields.industries: food processing (largely sugar milling), textiles, clothing, mining, chemicals, metal products, transport equipment, nonelectrical machinery, tourism
fields.languages: Creole 86.5%, Bhojpuri 5.3%, French 4.1%, two languages 1.4%, other 2.6% (includes English, one of the two official languages of the National Assembly, which is spoken by less than 1% of the…
fields.religions: Hindu 48.5%, Roman Catholic 26.3%, Muslim 17.3%, other Christian 6.4%, other 0.6%, none 0.7%, unspecified 0.1%
fields.legal: civil system based on French civil law with some elements of English common law
